recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future manufacturer-specific work should follow the separate FHIR-48400 extension-pack path rather than changing the base Medication.marketingAuthorizationHolder element.
issue_request: FHIR-32759 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Medication and asked to change Medication.sponsor to Medication.marketingAuthorizationHolder after a May 2021 BR&R/Pharmacy WGM discussion.
initial_application: Commit 934e7819020c72ee6e3ba509ecb5445a1850f109 mentioned FHIR-32759 but did not apply this rename. Commit 6cdd7b792e2241b7191584bd35915d4b0f9841f8 then renamed Medication.sponsor and the sponsor search parameter to Medication.marketingAuthorizationHolder and marketingauthorizationholder.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-35858, a later Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue, corrected the marketingAuthorizationHolder definition because it still described manufacturer, and b9257918056a31ebdc080627432cc94db78637e0 changed the definition to the current MAH wording. FHIR-48400 later treated manufacturer as distinct from marketingAuthorizationHolder and is already audited on the combined branch as an external-repo standard extension path.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the requested rename is already in current build-scope source and restoring the old sponsor/manufacturer comment language would conflict with later Pharmacy decisions.
